inputs.original_text: It's no surprise that Chief Minister M.K. Stalin and the DMK are advancing their manifesto brimming with expansive welfare handouts designed to chip away at personal responsibility and the traditional family unit. Doubling women's monthly aid to Rs 2,000 and distributing Rs 8,000 household coupons will only draw families away from self-reliance on their own kin and communities toward dependence on the government. Promising free motor pumpsets to farmers is yet another tactic to erode the independence that has sustained our rural culture for generations. Their references to FDI growth, job creation, additional support for fishermen, and a push for AI development are merely recycled progressive rhetoric intended to grow state authority while undermining national strength and cultural continuity.
inputs.modified_text: Chief Minister M.K. Stalin and the DMK are pushing forward with their manifesto of bloated welfare schemes that deliberately weaken personal responsibility and the traditional family unit. Doubling monthly aid for women to Rs 2,000 while handing out Rs 8,000 household coupons will only pull families away from depending on their own kin and local communities and toward relying on the state. Promising free motor pumpsets to farmers is another direct attack on the self-reliance that has held our rural culture together for generations. Their talk of FDI growth, job creation, extra support for fishermen, and AI development is just the usual progressive rhetoric aimed at expanding government control while chipping away at national strength and cultural continuity.
